title: "라이더 대기 시간도 돈 줘야"…배달앱 1800억 '폭탄' 터졌다 [곽용희의 일자리노트]
content:
AI 추천 뉴스




"라이더 대기 시간도 돈 줘야"…배달앱 1800억 '폭탄' 터졌다 [곽용희의 일자리노트]
도어대시, 뉴욕시에 1793억원 지급 합의
배달노동자 26만명 임금 체불 및 지연 지급
주문 기다리는 ‘대기시간’ 최저보수도 쟁점
뉴욕시, 플랫폼 데이터 1.5억건 직접 분석
플랫폼 데이터 제출 의무화...단속에 활용
배달노동자 26만명 임금 체불 및 지연 지급
주문 기다리는 ‘대기시간’ 최저보수도 쟁점
뉴욕시, 플랫폼 데이터 1.5억건 직접 분석
플랫폼 데이터 제출 의무화...단속에 활용


미국 음식배달 플랫폼 도어대시(DoorDash)가 배달노동자 임금 체불과 관련해 뉴욕시에 1억3150만달러(약 1793억원)를 지급하기로 합의했다. 뉴욕시 역사상 최대 규모의 노동 관련 합의이자 미국 음식배달 노동자를 대상으로 한 최대 규모의 합의금이다. 특히 뉴욕시가 도어대시의 1억5200만건의 결제 내역과 1억1000만시간의 노동 데이터를 직접 분석해 26만4000여명의 피해 노동자를 찾아냈다는 점에서 주목된다.
23일 월스트리트저널(WSJ), AP통신 등에 따르면 뉴욕시 소비자·노동자보호국(DCWP)은 도어대시와 배달노동자 임금 문제에 대해 1억3150만달러 규모의 합의를 체결했다. 이 가운데 1억1500만달러 이상(약 1569억원)은 노동자들에게 직접 지급되고, 1670만달러(약 228억원)는 벌금과 행정비용으로 뉴욕시에 귀속된다. 이번 조치는 양측이 합의한 것이다.
이번 합의는 배달노동자들이 임금을 제대로 받지 못했거나 지급이 늦어졌다는 민원을 제기하면서 시작됐다. 이에 따라 뉴욕시는 방대한 결제 및 노동 관련 데이터를 확보했고 이를 분석해 노동자별 지급액과 실제 노동시간을 대조했다. 그 결과 뉴욕시는 26만4000명 이상의 배달노동자가 임금이 체불되거나 법정 기한보다 늦게 지급된 것으로 조사됐다.
특히 뉴욕시의 배달노동자 최저보수 제도 위반 사례가 확인되면서 문제가 커졌다. 특히 '대기시간'이 핵심 쟁점이 됐다. 뉴욕시는 배달노동자가 앱에 접속해 다음 주문을 기다리는 시간까지 최저보수 산정에 반영해야 한다는 입장이다. 도어대시는 대기 시간을 뉴욕시와 다르게 계산했지만, 분쟁을 이어가기 보다는 합의를 선택한 것이다.
이에 따라 이번 합의에서 8300만달러 이상(약 1132억원)이 최저보수 산정 방식과 관련된 보상에 투입된다. 별도로 1230만달러(약 168억원)는 실제 미지급 또는 지연 임금과 관련된 노동자 보상에 사용된다. 추가 보상도 합의금에 포함됐다. 예를들어 1000달러(약 136만원)를 지급받지 못한 노동자는 3000달러(약 409만원)를 받게 되며, 1000달러를 법정 기한보다 늦게 받은 노동자는 2000달러(약 273만원)를 받는다.
도어대시는 고의적인 임금 착취가 아니라 기술적 오류와 복잡한 배달 과정에서 발생한 문제라고 주장했다. 뉴욕시 경계를 넘는 배달이나 복수의 픽업·배달, 주문 취소 과정에서 오류가 발생했으며 일부 지급 지연은 노동자가 잘못된 은행 정보를 입력하면서 발생했다는 설명이다. 회사는 문제가 된 기술적 사항을 수정했다고 밝혔다.
노동자가 별도로 피해 사실을 입증하거나 소송을 제기할 필요도 없이 뉴욕시가 플랫폼 데이터를 바탕으로 대상자를 특정하고 개인별 지급액을 산정한다. 정부가 플랫폼 데이터를 이용해 수십만명의 피해자를 일괄적으로 찾아냈다.
뉴욕시가 플랫폼 데이터를 직접 들여다볼 수 있었던 것은 배달노동자 최저보수 제도를 도입하면서 플랫폼에 데이터 제출 의무를 부과했기 때문이다. 뉴욕시는 2023년 미국에서 처음으로 앱 기반 음식배달 노동자를 대상으로 별도의 최저보수 제도를 도입했다. 법정 공방 끝에 같은 해 12월 4일부터 제도가 시행됐으며 당시 최저보수는 시간당 17.96달러(약 2만4500원)였다. 이후 차츰 인상돼 현재는 시간당 22.13달러(약 3만200원) 수준이다.
이번 사건은 이 데이터가 어떻게 노동 감독의 수단으로 활용될 수 있는지를 보여준다. 전통적인 근로감독은 감독관이 사업장을 방문해 임금대장과 근로계약서를 확인하는 방식이었다. 하지만 배달플랫폼은 배달기사가 언제 앱에 접속했는지, 얼마 동안 대기했는지, 어떤 주문을 수행했는지, 얼마를 지급받았는지가 모두 플랫폼 데이터로 남는다. 플랫폼 노동에 대한 노동감독이 ‘사업장에 가는 감독’에서 ‘데이터를 분석하는 감독’으로 바뀔 가능성을 보여주는 대목이다.

title: Rotes Kreuz startet Blutspende-Kampagne
content:
Nur drei bis vier Prozent der Bevölkerung spenden regelmäßig Blut, während die Nachfrage hoch bleibt -Blutspenden sind entscheidend für die medizinische Versorgung.
Ein Beispiel, wie lebensrettend Blutkonserven sein können: Karl Nestler aus der Oststeiermark hatte mit 16 Jahren einen schweren Zugunfall, bei dem er beide Beine verlor – Blutkonserven retteten sein Leben. Heute, mit 67 Jahren, betont Nestler die Bedeutung der Blutspende für Menschen in Notlagen.
Auf der Suche nach Blutspendern
Jede Blutspende hat zwei Gesichter – das des Helfenden, aber vor allem das des Überlebenden. Mit dieser Botschaft will der Blutspendedienst neue Spenderinnen und Spender gewinnen. Die Bereitschaft zu spenden ist auch in der Steiermark markant gesunken.
Dauerhafte Herausforderung
Die Kampagne „Tu’s für“ soll nun auf die Notwendigkeit von Blutspenden aufmerksam machen. Laut Nina Just vom Roten Kreuz Steiermark ist die Blutversorgung eine dauerhafte Herausforderung: „Die Blutversorgung muss 365 Tage im Jahr gesichert sein, und man darf aber nicht vergessen, gerade einmal drei bis vier Prozent der österreichischen Bevölkerung gehen regelmäßig Blutspenden, obwohl eigentlich jede und jeder im Ernstfall darauf angewiesen ist.“
Die Kampagne zielt darauf ab, die Spenderinnen und Spender sichtbar zu machen und zu zeigen, wie wichtig ihre Spenden sind.
Empfänger im Vordergrund
Die Kampagne läuft in der gesamten Steiermark und wird auf Plakaten, digitalen Bildschirmen und in sozialen Medien zu sehen sein. Rotkreuz-Präsident Michael Gruber betont, dass die Kampagne auch die Empfänger der Blutspenden in den Vordergrund rücken soll: „Wir wollen zeigen, dass dieses Blut, das man ja anonym spendet, wirklich hilft.“

title: Prezydent Zamościa: Mieszkańcom trzeba ciągle przypominać, gdzie są miejsca schronienia
content:
Panie prezydencie, jak daleko leży Zamość od granicy z Ukrainą?
To jest ok. 70 km. Do Hrubieszowa mamy ok. 50 km i do granicy kolejne 20 km. Przez Tomaszów Lubelski jest ok. 60 km.
Pytam o to, bo nagłówki „Rosja atakuje Ukrainę. Polska poderwała myśliwce” to niemal codzienność ostatnich dni. Czy ostrzeżenia RCB codziennie dotyczą mieszkańców Zamościa?
Dotyczą, bo dostajemy takie wiadomości z ostrzeżeniem. Mieszkańcy są zaniepokojeni, bo wprowadza to zamieszanie. Ale takie są wytyczne. To nie miasto wysyła takie wiadomości, ale Rządowe Centrum Bezpieczeństwa. Jako prezydent i miejskie służby dostajemy więcej tych informacji, a dodatkowo prowadzimy nasłuch na radiotelefonach.
W czwartek m.in. w Zamościu doszło do ewakuacji uczniów, urzędników. Jak przebiegała cała akcja? Coś trzeba poprawić na przyszłość?
Przez zarządzanie kryzysowe dostaliśmy polecenie włączenia systemów alarmowych. Zdecydowaliśmy, że w placówkach oświatowych dzieci i młodzież powinny zejść na najniższy poziom budynków. Podobne polecenia przekazaliśmy w urzędach i naszych instytucjach – urzędnicy również mieli zejść do wyznaczonych, bezpiecznych miejsc.
Nie wskazywaliśmy konkretnie piwnic, bo każdy powinien wiedzieć, gdzie w jego miejscu pracy znajduje się tzw. bezpieczne miejsce. Równocześnie błyskawicznie opublikowałem komunikat w mediach społecznościowych dla mieszkańców. Jeśli miałbym wskazać, co należy poprawić, to przede wszystkim komunikację z mieszkańcami. Pomimo szkoleń, przekazywania informacji przez strony rządowe, poradnika bezpieczeństwa, który trafiał do mieszkańców, oraz komunikatów w mediach społecznościowych, nadal wiele osób nie wie, jak powinno się zachować w sytuacji zagrożenia. Nie wszyscy wiedzą, gdzie miejsca schronienia się znajdują. Trzeba te informacje regularnie i konsekwentnie przypominać.
Widzę też, że w takich sytuacjach cała odpowiedzialność i krytyka spada na burmistrzów, starostów czy prezydentów miast. Tymczasem nie wszyscy mieszkańcy mają świadomość, że samorządowcy są jedynie wykonawcami określonych poleceń i procedur. Jeżeli nie wykonam polecenia, na przykład dotyczącego uruchomienia systemów alarmowych, a w konsekwencji wydarzy się coś złego, to ja ponoszę za to odpowiedzialność, również karną. Nie możemy więc sami decydować, czy dane procedury wdrażamy, czy nie.
Czytaj więcej
Zapisany w Konstytucji RP zrównoważony rozwój kraju powinien zakładać wsparcie również mniejszych ośrodków, które nie mają aż tak dużego wewnętrzne...
Dużo schronów i miejsc doraźnego ukrycia jest w Zamościu?
Mamy sporo miejsc służących do tymczasowego ukrycia ludności. Obecnie mamy 75 punktów schronienia na terenie miasta, w tym 20 będzie działać jako punkty schronienia. W tej chwili prowadzimy ekspertyzy. Lepiej – moim zdaniem – jest sprawdzić to, co mamy, i ewentualnie wyremontować, niż od razu budować nowe.
Miasto organizuje szkolenia dla mieszkańców z zachowań w sytuacjach kryzysowych?
Planujemy takie szkolenia. Będą na to środki. Zresztą już pierwsze takie spotkania były. I to nie jedno. To były szkolenia otwarte. Zapraszaliśmy chętnych. Informowaliśmy o szkoleniach m.in. w mediach społecznościowych miasta i tradycyjnych mediach. Raz były prowadzone w koszarach, raz w Sali Consulatus. Nie cieszyły się takim zainteresowaniem, jakbym chciał.
To może warto zmienić formułę szkoleń albo lepiej informować o nich mieszkańców?
Formuła szkoleń była dobra, bo sam byłem na podobnym szkoleniu w ub. roku w Akademii Pożarniczej w Warszawie. Informowaliśmy o tych szkoleniach w różny sposób, ale mieszkańców było niewielu, bo spotkania odbywały się albo w godzinach pracy, albo po godzinach pracy – wtedy mieszkańcy już spieszą się do domu i też nie ma dużego zainteresowania. Zawsze znajdzie się jakaś przyczyna, że mało osób przyszło. Ale te szkolenia to nasz obowiązek i będziemy je organizować cały czas.
Jak wyglądają tegoroczne zakupy z Programu Ochrony Ludności i Obrony Cywilnej? Środki idą tylko na wspomaganie szpitala, straży pożarnej, czy coś jeszcze?
Jeszcze w ub. roku kupiliśmy agregaty prądotwórcze stałe i mobilne, koparko-ładowarkę, cztery cysterny do przewozu wody pitnej na wypadek sytuacji kryzysowej oraz radiotelefony. A w tym roku przeznaczyliśmy pieniądze na ekspertyzy stanu schronów i miejsc doraźnego ukrycia i opracowanie dokumentacji miejsc ukrycia w czterech miejscach.
A teraz za ponad 100 mln zł modernizujemy oczyszczalnię ścieków, bo jeżeliby przyjrzeć się tej infrastrukturze krytycznej, to ona wymagała remontu. Nasza oczyszczalnia ma już 30 lat. W tej chwili jest już zabezpieczona w agregaty prądotwórcze, więc jeśli nawet nie będzie dostaw prądu, to będzie działać.
Czytaj więcej
Kołobrzeg to nie tylko 43 tysiące stałych mieszkańców, ale też ponad 21 tysięcy miejsc noclegowych. W sytuacji kryzysowej musimy być przygotowani n...
Zmieńmy temat. Jak długo jedzie się pociągiem z Zamościa do Warszawy?
Za długo.
Czyli? To są dwie, trzy godziny jazdy, czy więcej?
To są cztery godziny.
To ile jest kilometrów z Zamościa do Warszawy linią kolejową?
Ok. 250 km.
Regularne połączenia autobusowe pana miasta ze stolicą są, czy ich nie ma?
Są. Jeżdżą busy, autobusy. Tak więc są takie połączenia, ale chcielibyśmy, aby było ich znacznie więcej.
Kilka dni temu wystąpił pan do ministra infrastruktury z memoriałem dotyczącym inwestycji centralnych w infrastrukturę drogowo-kolejową, która połączy Zamość z centrum Polski. Dlaczego to takie ważne dla miasta?
Zamość jest miastem turystycznym wpisanym na listę Światowego Dziedzictwa UNESCO. Turystyka się u nas rozwija. My jako samorząd od kilku lat na nią stawiamy. Kiedy kilkanaście lat temu zmodernizowaliśmy Stare Miasto w Zamościu, to od razu zauważyliśmy wzrost zainteresowania ze strony turystów. Mamy nowoczesne zoo, coraz więcej imprez kulturalnych, bo w mieście jest sześć jednostek kultury.
Ale chcielibyśmy mieć jeszcze więcej turystów, bo z tego nasi przedsiębiorcy: hotelarze czy właściciele restauracji, żyją. Największym problemem, i to nie tylko jeśli chodzi o rozwój turystyki, ale całej lokalnej gospodarki, jest infrastruktura drogowa.
Nie tylko do Warszawy, ale też do Lublina jedzie się od nas długo, dlatego firmy, które mogłyby zainwestować w Zamościu w strefie ekonomicznej, gdzie mamy jeszcze wolne tereny inwestycyjne i możemy zwolnić inwestorów do 70 proc. z lokalnych podatków, wybierają inne ośrodki. Jeżeli będzie już gotowa DK17 i DK12, to liczę na to, że dużo się zmieni.
Strefa ekonomiczna jest u nas spora. Dziś to dziewięć firm, ale mamy jeszcze 10 wolnych hektarów. Ale brak dróg ekspresowych to jeden z głównych problemów, które wskazują przedsiębiorcy. Większe firmy nie chcą u nas inwestować czy przenosić produkcji.
Dostał pan od Dariusza Klimczaka jakąś odpowiedź na swój memoriał?
W środę otrzymałem informację, że moje pismo do resortu infrastruktury wpłynęło oficjalnie. Takie potwierdzenie otrzymali też posłowie z naszego regionu. Odpowiedzi jeszcze nie mam.
Czytaj więcej
Ostatni taki bodziec rozwojowy miasto dostało w 1975 r., gdy utworzono województwo elbląskie. Kolejny jest teraz, dzięki budowie kanału i realizowa...
A czego się pan właściwie spodziewa? Jakie działania powinien podjąć resort infrastruktury, by Zamość nie leżał na końcu świata, a w zasadzie niemal końcu Polski?
Wszystkie miasta na wschodzie Polski: Hrubieszów, Tomaszów Lubelski się wyludniają. Zamość też traci liczbowo. Jeszcze w latach 90. ub. wieku nasze miasto miało blisko 70 tys. mieszkańców. W tej chwili mamy 58 tys. mieszkańców i co roku ubywa nam tysiąc osób. Oczywiście część z nich buduje się na terenie gminy wiejskiej Zamość, ale nadal korzysta z miejskich usług.
Jednak część młodych ludzi wyjeżdża z Zamościa na studia i już nie wraca. Nasz ośrodek akademicki funkcjonuje prężnie, ale jednak większe miasta dają młodym większe możliwości. Lepszą pracę, wyższe zarobki. A co jest młodym ludziom potrzebne do życia? Praca i mieszkanie. My mieszkania budujemy. Powstają nowe bloki w ramach Społecznej Inicjatywy Mieszkaniowej czy TBS-ów. Więc będą mieszkania dla ludzi z niewielkimi czynszami, z możliwością ich wykupu. Ale dobra praca też jest ważna.
Jeżeli ARP czy ministerstwo infrastruktury nie pomoże nam, to my sami jako samorząd nie jesteśmy w stanie tego rozwinąć. Widzimy, że duże firmy inwestują w Warszawie, w Szczecinie, w Krakowie czy na Śląsku. Rząd mógłby w ramach deglomeracji przenieść jakąś instytucję centralną do Zamościa. Albo zachęcić jakąś firmę, by tu, na naszym terenie, rozwinęła swoje skrzydła.
Mamy ludzi chętnych do pracy, mamy strefę ekonomiczną, ale brakuje nam wsparcia, bo inwestycje są realizowane albo w centrum kraju, w Warszawie, albo na zachodzie Polski. Wschód jak zawsze jest zostawiony sam sobie. I niech radzi sobie sam.
To ciągle taka Polska B...
Nie chcę tego mówić, ale ciągle tak to wygląda. I jeżeli ktoś nie tupnie i nie pokaże, że trzeba to zmienić, i nadal wszystko będzie szło jak teraz, to będzie coraz gorzej. Z roku na rok Zamość będzie miał tysiąc mieszkańców mniej.
I będzie to miasto niemal samych emerytów. Jak wiele innych.
Niektórzy już mówią, że miasta na wschodzie, ale też mniejsze ośrodki w innych częściach kraju, gdzie depopulacja jest bardzo duża, powinny już dostosowywać swoją ofertę do tego, by emerytom żyło się tam dobrze.
Oczywiście to robimy, ale ja dalej twierdzę, że da się jeszcze wiele rzeczy zmienić. Po ostatnich wydarzeniach w Zamościu, po Rajdzie Koguta, który kończy się w naszym mieście, przez dwa miesiące nie mieliśmy miejsc, żeby zakwaterować ludzi. A w Zamościu jest aż 4,5 tys. miejsc hotelowych.
To znaczy, że idziemy w dobrym kierunku, ale te drogi, ta infrastruktura kolejowa, są nam potrzebne, żeby rozwinąć skrzydła.
Bez rządowego wsparcia na razie nic nie wychodzi z pana obietnicy stworzenia tysiąca nowych miejsc pracy w Zamościu, co pan deklarował 2,5 roku temu w czasie kampanii samorządowej?
Miejsca pracy w Zamościu już powstały. I na pewno powstaną kolejne, ale czy to będzie tysiąc, czy więcej? Aby zatrudnić tysiąc, czy dwa, czy trzy tysiące ludzi, musimy mieć jakąś fabrykę, jakieś przetwórstwo. Samorząd tworzy warunki do powstawania firm. I my to robimy.
Mieliśmy inwestora, który chciał zrobić fabrykę leków z osocza ludzkiego. Bardzo fajna inwestycja. Rozmawialiśmy z nim przez pół roku. Wszystko szło w dobrą stronę. Jednak po wyborach w Stanach Zjednoczonych, które wygrał prezydent Donald Trump, ten inwestor przyjechał i powiedział, że sytuacja jest niepewna, więc rezygnuje.
Wiadomo, jak dużo źródeł geotermalnych jest na terenie miasta? Jaką temperaturę ma ta woda?
Kilka lat temu były robione badania. Okazało się, że pod Zamościem jest ciepła woda. W jednej części miasta jej temperatura waha się w przedziale 70–80 st. C. Jest chętny inwestor, który chciałby zrobić aquapark, może nie od razu z wykorzystaniem geotermii, ale z czasem byłaby możliwość przełączenia na te źródła.
Jednak koszt odwiertu próbnego to kilkadziesiąt milionów złotych. Jeżeli jednak miasto pozyska na ten cel środki zewnętrzne, zrobi odwiert i stworzy projekt komercyjny, to w chwili, gdy wejdzie w to firma komercyjna, samorząd będzie musiał uzyskane pieniądze zwrócić. I koło się zamyka.
Co w takim razie z planowanym kompleksem Termy Zamojskie? Powstanie, czy nie?
W tej chwili jesteśmy na etapie rozmów z inwestorem, który złożył już projekty. Mamy koncepcję, mamy wskazane dwa miejsca i myślę, że decyzja o budowie zapadnie w ciągu dwóch miesięcy. Rozmawiamy z konserwatorem zabytków, z Narodowym Instytutem Dziedzictwa, bo oni wydają opinię. Jesteśmy po wstępnych rozmowach i myślę, że wszystko idzie w dobrą stronę.
Czytaj więcej
Potrzeby inwestycyjne miasta są znacznie większe niż dostępne środki dotacyjne. Dlatego kredyty, pożyczki czy emisja obligacji są dziś niezbędnym n...
Ile drzew już udało się miastu zasadzić przez niemal połowę pana kadencji?
Myślę, że już ok. tysiąca drzew zasadziliśmy. Krzewów, bylin i innych nie liczę.
Ale do 10 tys. obiecanych przez pana jeszcze daleko, a kadencji zostało 2,5 roku...
Zasadzimy. I mówię o samych drzewach. Rodzice każdego dziecka, które rodzi się w Zamościu, mogą u nas zasadzić dla niego drzewo. W tej chwili mamy nowego ogrodnika miejskiego, który planuje kolejny skwer z miejscem na dosadzenie tych drzewek dla małych mieszkańców Zamościa.
Praktycznie wszystkie ronda w mieście są już zielone. Na naszym Rynku pojawiło się 12 lip. Co prawda w donicach, bo konserwator zabytków nie zezwala na naruszenie płyty Rynku. Ale Zamość ciągle się zazielenia.

title: Citizen search for Nannup Four gets underway
content:
Citizen search for Nannup Four begins in tough bushland in southern WA
In short:
A renewed search to find any trace of the Nannup Four has begun in WA's South West.
Chantelle McDougall and her daughter Leela have not been seen since their disappearance in July 2007, along with her partner Simon Kadwill and friend Tony Popic.
Ms McDougall's parents are hopeful, but realistic, about the potential for the search to provide long-awaited answers.
A group of citizen searchers will begin scouring a stretch of almost impenetrable wilderness in southern Western Australia this week to find answers in one of the country's most baffling missing persons cases.
Chantelle McDougall and her five-year-old daughter Leela vanished from the outskirts of Nannup in July 2007, along with her partner Simon Kadwill and their friend Tony Popic.
They've become known as the Nannup Four.
In the days after their disappearance, Ms McDougall's family were under the impression the four had emigrated to Brazil, but reported their daughter and grandchild missing when they failed to hear from them.
Their bank accounts were untouched, and their passports hadn't been used.
Loading...Mr Kadwill, whose real name is Gary Felton, was living under a stolen identity while running an online cult in which he espoused doomsday beliefs.
He had spoken of a plan to "wander into the wilderness" and carry out a murder-suicide.
A 2017 coronial inquest failed to determine if the four were dead or alive.
ABC investigation sparks new search
Following a long-running investigation, The ABC's Expanse: The Nannup Four uncovered police error, new details of coercive control and evidence pointing to a possible burial site.
Among the podcast's audience was Matt Strickland, an exploration geologist with a hand in a number of private searches for missing people.
He contacted the McDougall family and offered his assistance.
"There's not a lot I can say, but there's a lot I can do," Mr Strickland said.
Mr Strickland is the vice-president of Find Our Lost Loved Ones (FOLLO), a missing persons search team based in Tasmania.
It began with a successful volunteer-led search to find the remains of missing Belgian hiker Celine Cremer.
The group went on to locate the remains of another missing Tasmanian, Peter Willoughby, in May this year.
"We've managed to [solve] two missing persons cases in six months with very limited resources," Mr Strickland said.
"So we know it's possible."
Months of correspondence with Chantelle McDougall's uncle Barry McIntosh followed.
A retired Victorian police detective, Mr McIntosh has continued to probe his niece's disappearance, with a fresh search effort his long-term goal.
Call for volunteers
In August, Mr Strickland put a call out on ABC radio asking for people with bush experience to volunteer their time for the two-week search in WA's South West.
More than 40 volunteers signed on over the following weeks.
"We are going to be operating on what could potentially be a crime scene," Mr Strickland said.
"So we need to be responsible; we need to have responsible people there."
Despite previous success, he concedes the Nannup Four case brings significant additional challenges.
"The searches that we've had so far, we've been searching for people who were lost and probably died of exposure, and they wanted to be found," he said.
"In the case of the Nannup Four, it appears that they didn't want to be."
Where will the search focus be?
The search will focus on bushland near the WA town of Northcliffe, about 100km south of Nannup, where the group was living, and 350km south of Perth.
In the days surrounding the disappearance, either Mr Kadwill or Mr Popic purchased two bus tickets, with Northcliffe believed to be the final destination.
Three months later, in October 2007, prisoners carrying out track clearing in bushland near the town reported finding items of clothing and a "smell of death" in the area.
Police subsequently searched the area, but have since admitted they were in the wrong location.
A team of cadaver dogs were taken to the right location in 2024, where they picked up the scent of human remains.
The near-impenetrable terrain will also increase the complexity for the search teams.
"It's all regrown, and it's quite thick, and it is formerly a logging area," Mr Strickland said.
"So the ground itself … kind of chaotic would be one way of describing it."
A LiDAR drone survey to identify ground disturbances, and the same cadaver dog team used in 2024, will help assist the search effort.
Family grateful for help
The search will run for two weeks, with the key aim of finding any evidence of the four's remains or possessions in the area.
At its centre will be Jim and Cath McDougall, Chantelle's parents, who are driving across Australia from their home in regional Victoria to assist.
"I think it's absolutely amazing," Mrs McDougall said.
"I'm so grateful to all these people helping because for years it felt like we had no-one on our side trying to help us.
"I want to be really involved. I want to help search if I can, if I'm not a nuisance, and want to be there in amongst it all."
But after years of waiting for closure, Mrs McDougall is balancing the hope of finding answers with the reality she may never get them.
"We try not to get our hopes up too much," she said.
"Because over the years, we felt that all the little leads and things we had have come to a dead end, and we sort of still don't know anything.
"I'm just hoping we get some really good results."
Follow Expanse: The Nannup Four on ABC listen to hear every episode of season six.

title: ESIC Series: Paper 3 Strengthening demand-side engagement: Recommendations from the Evidence Synthesis Infrastructure Collaborative (ESIC) Working Group 1.
content: A persistent challenge to evidence use is the disconnect between producers of evidence syntheses and users. This gap is driven by well-documented barriers faced by decision-makers, including limited access to high-quality or relevant evidence emanating from evaluation and research processes, findings not being delivered in a timely way, insufficient capacity for knowledge translation and evidence uptake, and resource constraints. The Evidence Synthesis Infrastructure Collaborative (ESIC) was established to guide the Wellcome Trust's planned investment in optimising the impact of research on policy and practice. ESIC Working Group 1 (WG1) aimed to explore demand-side engagement, specifically optimising engagement between evidence synthesis producers and evidence users and identifying solutions addressing high-priority challenges in the connection between evidence synthesis and policy / practice. WG1 undertook a six-month, multi-stage planning process to systematically identify challenges, assess existing capabilities, and develop scalable solutions to support demand-side engagement. The group, comprising professionals from diverse sectors and regions, was guided by the 'double diamond' design framework, a Capability Maturity Model and an Impact-Effort Matrix. The activities comprised four stages: discovery (capability profile assessment), definition (capability maturity assessment), development (identify solutions), and delivery (prioritise solutions). Data collection included surveys, workshops, and consultations within and beyond WG1, with external stakeholders purposefully recruited by WG1 members. Findings revealed significant gaps in data, technology, platforms, resources, processes, and systems, with most demand-side capabilities rated as 'initial' or 'developing'. The assessment highlighted sectoral and regional disparities, particularly affecting marginalised groups. Five potential solutions were developed. Three were considered high priority - establishment of regional demand-side secretariats, provision of support to evidence intermediaries, and co-production labs. Two were recognised as valuable complements - thematic repositories such as question banks and evidence-gap maps; and grants to end-users to build evidence synthesis awareness and capacity. These actions are designed to enhance capacity, foster collaboration, and promote equity in evidence-informed decision-making. Challenges related to demand-side engagement vary significantly across sectors and geographic contexts. Effective solutions therefore encompass a broad array of strategies addressing factors including low engagement of marginalised communities; structural imbalances in research focus; restrictive paywalls; and lack of transparency in decision-making. Because most identified capabilities were heavily skewed to evidence synthesisers, support of demand-side engagement is a relatively high priority. A two-stream approach was proposed, accounting for the need to be flexible with sequencing. The first stream would focus on piloting and scaling in relatively mature sectors and regions, while the second stream would invest in building foundational capacity in underrepresented sectors and regions. Effective demand-side engagement requires structured, inclusive, and context-sensitive strategies, with intermediaries playing a pivotal role. Sequencing and equity considerations are essential to ensure that evidence synthesis reaches and serves all stakeholders, particularly in underrepresented regions and sectors. If implemented as proposed, these recommendations offer a pathway to a more responsive, equitable, and sustainable evidence ecosystem.

title: After an elephant became trapped shoulder-deep in a sinkhole, these brave rangers came to its aid
content:
The officers at the Sheldrick Wildlife Trust are no strangers when it comes to rescuing elephants from sinkholes — in 2025, the conservation organization rescued 17 in total.
The Sheldrick Wildlife Trust is based in Kenya, where sinkholes and ground fissures are relatively common, particularly along the active tectonic fault lines of the Great Rift Valley, a divergence of three major tectonic plates pulling apart from one another.
On February 25, the Kenya Wildlife Service responded to reports of a bull elephant trapped shoulder-deep in a sinkhole in Chakama, a region roughly 30 miles inland from the Indian Ocean.
“Sheldrick Wildlife Trust pilot Roan Carr-Hartley flew down to the scene, where he met with the Kulalu anti-poaching team and KWS,” the nonprofit stated in a press release.
“While it was too deep and steep to escape, he could move around inside, which made it challenging for teams to position the straps needed to free him,” it continued.
The elephant was in a panic, which meant that the rangers couldn’t get too close without risking their own safety.
Carr-Hartley called Campaign Limo, who heads a mobile vet unit in the Greater Tsavo Conservation Area, who was busy helping with another rescue operation. With the veterinarian miles away, Carr-Hartley and the KWS rangers knew they had to continue the operation without anaesthetising the bull and pulling it to safety.
“Finally, the team managed to loop straps behind the bull and attached them to a vehicle,” the Sheldrick Wildlife Trust reported. “Inch by inch, they pulled him from his muddy trap.”
In video footage of the incident, the elephant’s body language seemed to change after it realized that it was being helped, not harmed. After a harrowing back-and-forth, the exhausted elephant is finally pulled free from the sinkhole.
“This was a very challenging operation, but the team didn’t give up,” the organization wrote. “A life was saved, leaving all involved with a deep feeling of accomplishment.”
On YouTube, people were quick to offer their praise for the organization.
“What seems like an impossible rescue made totally possible by a community of passionate can-do individuals only wanting the best for these animals,” one user wrote.
“It was amazing to see how quickly he realized they were here to help and stopped wasting energy struggling at the sight of them,” another person commented. “Phenomenal work all around.”
One YouTube user said: “These individuals — each and every one participating in this rescue — are tipping the scales to the good on our planet.”

title: 30 de ani de la căsătoria Majestății Sale Margareta cu Principele Radu
content:
30 de ani de la căsătoria Majestății Sale Margareta cu Principele Radu
Astăzi, la Palatul Elisabeta, într-o atmosferă de aleasă discreție și cu acea noblețe sobră care însoțește marile momente ale unei Case Regale, a fost sărbătorită împlinirea a treizeci de ani de la cununia Majestății Sale Margareta și a Principelui Radu.
Treizeci de ani de viață împreună și, mai presus de toate, treizeci de ani puși sub semnul datoriei, al credinței și al slujirii României.
Pentru mulți români și pentru numeroase familii din țara noastră, cuplul regal rămâne un reper de statornicie, discreție, demnitate și devotament. Într-o vreme în care multe dintre rânduielile lumii se schimbă cu repeziciune, un asemenea drum, parcurs cu aceeași măsură, cu același respect și cu aceeași credință în datoria față de țară, dobândește o însemnătate aparte.
Ceremonia de astăzi, la Palatul Elisabeta, a reunit oaspeți de seamă, între care reprezentanți ai Crucii Roșii Române, ai Comitetului Olimpic, ministrul Raed Arafat și alți apropiați ai Casei Regale. Ieri seară a avut loc o cină în familie, cu invitați din străinătate. A fost o sărbătoare fără fast ostentativ, dar cu acea eleganță firească și acea măsură desăvârșită care se cuvin unei Familii Regale.
Muzica a întregit această zi într-un chip deosebit. Orchestra de copii (copii de 10-15 ani) și Corul Regal, dirijat de Răzvan Apetrei, au oferit un moment muzical de aleasă frumusețe, într-o întâlnire simbolică între tinerețe, tradiție și prietenie. Cine s-ar fi așteptat ca la Casa Regală să auzi pe lângă Johann Sebastian Bach, John Lennon,Elvis Presley sau melodii precum „What a Wonderful World” sau Summertime.
Într-o asemenea zi, se cuvine să ne întoarcem cu gândul la începuturi.
La 21 septembrie 1996, la Lausanne, în Elveția, a avut loc cununia religioasă a Majestății Sale Margareta și a Principelui Radu. Era un timp în care Regelui Mihai nu îi era încă îngăduit să se întoarcă în țara sa. Să nu uităm. Cununia s-a săvârșit în Biserica Sfântul Gherasim, într-o ceremonie de aleasă solemnitate, în limbile română, latină, greacă și engleză. Români veniți din țară, precum și membri ai comunităților românești, îndeosebi din Elveția, au dorit să fie de față la acel ceas însemnat din viața Familiei Regale a României. De atunci s-au scurs treizeci de ani.
Trei decenii în care Majestatea Sa Margareta și Principele Radu și-au așezat viața sub semnul unei datorii pe care au primit-o cu demnitate și pe care au împlinit-o cu statornicie: aceea de a sluji România.
În acest răstimp, cuplul regal a efectuat 400 de vizite în Europa, America și Africa, reprezentând România și națiunea română cu demnitate și consecvență.
Peste 55.000 de români au fost primiți la Palatul Elisabeta, la Săvârșin și la diferitele întâlniri și evenimente desfășurate de-a lungul acestor ani — fie în cadrul întâlnirilor din Palat, fie în audiențe private, fie cu prilejul sărbătorilor de Crăciun.
Sunt cifre care, dincolo de aparența lor statistică, vorbesc despre oameni și despre o legătură neîntreruptă cu națiunea. În timp ce politicienii de după 1990 se perindă rapid, mânați de propriile interese egoiste, Familia Regală slujește cu devotament neîncetat, totul pentru țară.
În ceea ce privește diplomația regală, în ultimii treizeci de ani au fost efectuate 152 de vizite externe, însemnând întâlniri cu șefi de stat, suverani, președinți și șefi de guvern, din Europa și din întreaga lume. Au fost vizite în Canada, în India și la Vatican, au fost întâlniri în mari capitale și în locuri în care România a fost reprezentată cu demnitate.
Ca gazde, la Palatul Elisabeta, din anul 2000 până astăzi, au fost primiți peste 65 de șefi de stat, de parlament și de guvern.
Poate că nu ne dăm întotdeauna seama ce înseamnă asemenea întâlniri pentru țara noastră. În diplomația unei națiuni, primirea unui șef de stat, a unui suveran sau a unui înalt reprezentant al unui guvern nu este doar un act protocolar. Este o formă de recunoaștere, de respect și de construire a unor punți între țări și între oameni.
În total, s-au însumat peste 12.000 de angajamente publice în țară și în străinătate. Este o cifră impresionantă, dar adevărata ei însemnătate nu stă în număr, ci în miile de întâlniri, în orele de muncă, în drumurile străbătute și în oamenii întâlniți în numele României.
Aceasta este, în fond, esența diplomației regale: continuitatea și stabilitatea.
Nu doar marile ceremonii și întâlnirile solemne alcătuiesc această misiune, ci și lucrul statornic, săptămână după săptămână, uneori cu mai multe angajamente într-o singură zi; drumurile către comunitățile mari și mici ale țării; întâlnirea cu oameni simpli, cu instituții, cu tineri, în școli, în locuri sărace alte țării, cu oameni de cultură și cu cei care, fiecare după puterea și rostul său, țin vie România.
În fiecare an, Familia Regală oferă pachete de Crăciun celor aflați în nevoie la Săvârșin (pildă stau imaginile din decembrie) și trimite și semnează peste 500 de felicitări de Crăciun.
Sunt gesturi care nu caută zgomotul lumii, dar care, prin continuitatea lor, dobândesc noblețea tradiției și înțelesul unei datorii împlinite.
Sunt treizeci de ani în care cuplul regal a muncit pentru România cu o statornicie care nu are nevoie de laudă, pentru că însăși continuitatea acestei munci este mărturia ei.
Prima vizită a Majestății Sale Margareta în România a avut loc în 1990, în primele zile ale lunii ianuarie. La 18 ianuarie, Majestatea Sa a vizitat Spitalul Colentina, un orfelinat, dispensarul rural din Brănești și casa Doinei Cornea de la Cluj.
Nu este lucru ușor să muncești pentru țară neîncetat, indiferent de cum te simți, de cum sunt vremurile politice sau economice, pe timp de pace sau război. Un rege nu are concediu de odihnă, nici nu-și dă demisia. Nu este lucru ușor să așezi binele țării mai presus de interesele personale și să faci aceasta cu măsură, cu răbdare și cu o diplomație aleasă, pe tărâm cultural, social și economic.
De ce subliniez economic, deoarece în toate vizitele externe, oamenii de afaceri sunt prezenți, iar ambasadorii României din țările respective îi pregătesc deseori vizite în zone de afaceri dar și în spații academice sau militare. În felul acesta, diplomația regală devine și un loc de întâlnire între oameni, instituții și națiuni, un loc în care interesele României pot fi făcute cunoscute cu demnitate și bună-cuviință.
Majestatea Sa Margareta a oferit patronajul regal pentru 47 de instituții, organizații și evenimente, iar Principele Radu pentru 25 de organizații și instituții.
Prin aceste patronaje, Familia Regală se află aproape de acele inițiative care dau substanță vieții culturale, sociale, educaționale și civice a României.
Fundația Regală Margareta a României a ajutat, în cei treizeci de ani, peste 400.000 de copii, iar prin filialele din cele șase țări, a adunat peste 16 milioane de euro pentru diferite proiecte.
Sunt cifre care poate nu sunt îndeajuns cunoscute. Și poate că tocmai de aceea merită rostite astăzi, cu măsură și cu recunoștință, pentru că în spatele fiecărei cifre se află un copil, o familie, un destin și, uneori, o șansă schimbată în bine.
Majestatea Sa a vorbit de cinci ori în Parlamentul României și a participat la 14 sesiuni solemne ale Camerelor Parlamentului României.
Principele Radu a semnat peste 40 de volume publicate la edituri prestigioase din România, adăugând misiunii sale publice o dimensiune intelectuală și culturală de însemnătate. Leadership autentic.
Privite toate împreună, aceste fapte alcătuiesc nu doar bilanțul unor decenii, ci mărturia unei vieți publice așezate sub semnul datoriei.
Treizeci de ani nu sunt doar o aniversare, înseamnă răbdare, statornicie, responsabilitate, respect. Înseamnă să știi că unele datorii nu se împlinesc într-o zi și că slujirea unei țări nu este o îndeletnicire vremelnică, ci o vocație.
Majestatea Sa Margareta și Principele Radu au ales să așeze România în centrul misiunii lor publice. Au reprezentat-o peste hotare, au primit oameni la Palatul
Elisabeta, au sprijinit cultura, educația și societatea și au păstrat, cu discreție și demnitate, legătura dintre Coroană și națiune.
Iar astăzi, la Palatul Elisabeta, treizeci de ani de cununie au fost sărbătoriți în chipul cel mai potrivit: cu discreție, cu eleganță, cu prietenie și cu recunoștință.
Pentru că adevărata noblețe nu stă în fast, ci în statornicia cu care o datorie este dusă la împlinire.
La mulți ani Familiei Regale a României!
Și fie ca anii ce vor veni să păstreze aceeași lumină a devotamentului, aceeași măsură a demnității și aceeași neclintită credință în România.

title: Legarda welcomes historic Bangsamoro polls, condemns violence
content:
Legarda welcomes historic Bangsamoro polls, condemns violence
MANILA, Philippines — The Bangsamoro parliamentary elections on Sept. 14 were a “historic first step” to self-governance in the region, Sen. Loren Legarda said in a statement.
“After generations who endured conflict and uncertainty, the people held in their hands the most powerful instrument of democracy—the ballot. Every vote cast carried with it the hopes of a people who have fought long and hard for peace, dignity, and the right to shape their own future,” Legarda said.
She is a co-author and co-sponsor of the measure that became Republic Act No. 12317, which set the first regular parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). She also served as co-chairperson of the Philippine Congress–Bangsamoro Parliament Forum (PCBPF) and chairperson of its Senate panel, the institutional mechanism for cooperation and coordination between the Philippine Congress and the Bangsamoro Parliament.
READ: Parties led by ex-rebels dominate BARMM polls
The exercise paved the way for the transition from the Bangsamoro Transition Authority to the region’s first elected Parliament.
“For many years, the Bangsamoro peace process was carried forward through negotiations, agreements, legislation, and the difficult work of building institutions. The September 14 elections gave the Bansamoro people the opportunity to choose their leaders under the parliamentary system envisioned for the region. That achievement deserves recognition and protection,” she stressed.
‘No room for violence’
Legarda condemned, however, the violence surrounding the vote, with two shooting incidents in Cotabato City that left four people dead and 18 others wounded, according to Chairman George Garcia of the Commission on Elections.
“At the very moment when the Bangsamoro people were exercising their right to choose their leaders, lives were lost, and families were left grieving. I condemn these acts in the strongest terms,” Legarda said.
“There’s no room for violence and threats in elections borne out of a long peace process and the recognition of the Bangsamoro’s right to govern its own region. No political ambition, rivalry, or disagreement can justify violence. The will of the people must be determined by their votes, never by fear, intimidation, or force,” she added
Legarda called on election authorities and law enforcement agencies to investigate the incidents of violence, protect affected communities, and ensure that accountability follows wherever the evidence leads.
She also urged candidates, political leaders, and their supporters to respect the results and refrain from actions that could further endanger communities or undermine public confidence in the electoral process.
“The measure of this historic election will not end when the last ballot is counted. It will be measured by whether communities become safer, whether children have greater opportunities to learn, whether families can build dignified livelihoods, and whether the people of Bangsamoro, regardless of faith, ethnicity, or political affiliation, can see themselves represented in their government,” Legarda said.
READ: Unfinished peace process: What’s next after BARMM polls?
Partners in government
She urged Congress to remain a committed partner of the elected Bangsamoro Parliament.
“We reached this historic moment because generations of Filipinos, especially the Bangsamoro people, chose, again and again, to believe that peace was possible. Some of them did not live to see this election. We honor their sacrifices by protecting what has been built and by ensuring that democracy takes deeper root in the Bangsamoro,” she said.
Legarda also congratulated the newly elected members of the Bangsamoro Parliament.
“I congratulate the newly elected members of the Bangsamoro Parliament on the trust and confidence placed in them by the Bangsamoro people. As the first elected leaders of the Parliament, you have the unique opportunity to help shape this new chapter in the region’s history. I trust that they will honor that mandate through principled, inclusive, and responsive leadership,” Legarda said.
“For my part, I will continue to work with the Bangsamoro Parliament and our partners in government to strengthen the institutions of self-governance, advance peace and development, and help build a safer and more prosperous future for the people of the Bangsamoro. The work does not end with this historic election. We must continue it together,” she added. /atm

title: Carton au potager contre les pluies d’automne : bonne ou mauvaise idée.
content:
L’automne impose chaque année le même défi aux jardiniers : faire face aux précipitations diluviennes et aux maladies cryptogamiques qui menacent les cultures. Alors que les pluies battantes transforment la terre en boue, une méthode d’une simplicité désarmante a envahi les conversations des passionnés de potager. Il suffirait de déposer de simples cartons d’emballage entre les rangs de légumes pour éradiquer les mauvaises herbes, préserver l’humidité et protéger le feuillage des attaques du mildiou. Cette pratique, économique et à portée de main, soulève pourtant de vives controverses au sein de la communauté agricole et scientifique. L’utilisation du carton sur une terre vivante est-elle une véritable aubaine agronomique ou une fausse bonne idée dangereuse pour l’écosystème du sol ?
L’effet bouclier du carton face aux intempéries automnales
Pour comprendre l’engouement autour de cette technique, il faut d’abord observer le mécanisme des maladies fongiques en automne. Lorsque les gouttes de pluie frappent un sol nu, elles projettent des micro-gouttelettes de boue chargées de spores sur les feuilles basses des plantes. C’est le vecteur principal d’infection du mildiou, un microorganisme dévastateur pour les solanacées et les cucurbitacées. En intercalant un matériau opaque entre la terre et l’air, le jardinier crée un écran physique infranchissable qui stoppe net ce phénomène d’éclaboussure.
Au-delà de cette barrière sanitaire, le carton agit par occultation. Privées de la lumière du soleil indispensable à la photosynthèse, les graines d’adventices (les plantes indésirables couramment appelées mauvaises herbes) ne peuvent pas germer. Cet étouffement sélectif simplifie considérablement le travail d’entretien tout en réduisant la compétition pour les nutriments du sol. De plus, durant les périodes d’accalmie, cette couverture limite le dessèchement de la terre par évaporation, ce qui permet de réguler les besoins en arrosage.
À terme, en se désintégrant doucement, le carton est censé apporter de la matière carbonée au sol. Ce processus attire les lumbricidés (les vers de terre de surface et d’infaune) ainsi qu’une multitude de micro-organismes décomposeurs qui transforment la cellulose en humus fertiles. Mais cette promesse écologique cache une réalité beaucoup plus nuancée.
Risque d’asphyxie et pollution : l’envers du décor
Derrière l’apparente sobriété de ce matériau se dissimulent des contraintes physiques et chimiques souvent ignorées. La première menace réside dans l’effet d’imperméabilisation. Si le carton utilisé est trop épais ou s’il est posé complètement sec sur une terre déjà déshydratée, il forme un toit étanche. Au lieu d’irriguer le sol, la pluie glisse en surface par ruissellement, laissant les racines assoiffées en dessous.
Le danger le plus grave concerne la biologie de la terre. La respiration du sol repose sur des échanges gazeux constants entre l’atmosphère et la porosité de la terre. Les experts en pédologie (la science qui étudie la structure et l’évolution des sols) rappellent que les bactéries aérobies et la faune du sol ont impérativement besoin d’oxygène pour décomposer la matière. Posé en plaques contiguës, le carton colmate ces pores et risque de provoquer une asphyxie du milieu. Cela favorise l’apparition de micro-organismes anaérobies responsables de phénomènes de fermentation et de pourrissement des racines.
Enfin, la composition exacte des emballages soulève une légitime inquiétude environnementale. Bien que le papier soit biodégradable, la plupart des cartons industriels contiennent des adjuvants chimiques : résines d’étanchéité, colles de synthèse à base de polymères et traces d’encres d’impression. Même en sélectionnant un carton brun apparemment brut, le risque de relarguer des microparticules ou des polluants résiduels dans le sol d’un potager biologique n’est jamais totalement nul. Sans compter que le détournement massif de ces emballages prive la filière du recyclage d’une ressource industrielle précieuse.
Appliquer les bonnes pratiques sans sacrifier la terre
Faut-il pour autant bannir définitivement le carton du potager ? Pas nécessairement, à condition d’appliquer un protocole rigoureux et temporaire. Pour minimiser les risques, l’usage du carton doit être réservé à la préparation de nouvelles parcelles ou à la mise en repos hivernale des planches de culture, mais jamais sur des cultures pérennes en pleine croissance.
L’installation exige des étapes précises :
- La sélection : bannir impérativement les cartons plastifiés, imprimés en couleur, blanchis au chlore ou munis de rubans adhésifs. Seul le carton brun ondulé non traité convient.
- La préparation du terrain : le sol doit être abondamment arrosé avant la pose pour garantir la continuité capillaire de l’eau.
- L’humidification du matériau : le carton doit être détrempé avant et après son installation.
- Le lestage : fixer l’ensemble avec des pierres ou du bois pour résister au vent.
- Le doublement végétal : recouvrir systématiquement le carton d’une épaisse couche de paille, de feuilles mortes ou de bois raméal fragmenté (BRF). Ce composite recrée la litière forestière et accélère la décomposition sans asphyxier le sol.
Pour ceux qui refusent de prendre le moindre risque avec des matériaux transformés, les alternatives naturelles demeurent la référence. La paille, le compost mûr ou la toile géotextile (bien que synthétique) constituent des solutions durables. En intégrant le carton de manière raisonnée et ponctuelle, le jardinier protège ses légumes d’automne tout en préservant l’équilibre fragile de son sol.

title: Vaping rates for schoolchildren appear to drop - is it falling out of favour?
content:
Vaping rates for schoolchildren appear to drop - is it falling out of favour?
- Published
For the first time in several years, the rates of vaping among schoolchildren in Wales appear to be falling.
The most recent data from a survey of more than 130,000 young people in secondary schools showed that across all age groups, habits are changing for both vaping and smoking.
Public health officials say the "significant fall" since 2023 coincides with the ban on disposable vapes being announced, though the impact of the law change is still being evaluated.
The findings are from the student health and well-being survey which has been carried out every two years by a research network made up of Public Health Wales, external, Cardiff University and the Welsh government.
Questions about vaping were added in 2017, and the survey carried out last year shows that 9,100 learners between Year 7 to 11 vape regularly, which is 3,200 fewer than 2023.
Meanwhile, the numbers smoking regularly have halved to 1,600.
The answers rely on self-reporting from young people, meaning the study depends on honesty and accurate recollection from participants, but it paints a snapshot of behaviours over nearly a decade.
Since the last survey in 2023, the proportion of learners in Years 7 to 11 who say they have tried a vape fell from 25.7% to 21%.
In the same period, the number who described themselves as regular vapers or smokers was much lower, and fell from 8% to 5.9%.
Officials said there has also been a faster drop in the numbers who said they smoke regularly, with the rate now just 1.8%.
So why are some young people turning away from vaping, after several years of the numbers going in the opposite direction?
Jay, 17, from Barry Sixth Form, in the Vale of Glamorgan, said he thinks his year group narrowly avoided the hype when vapes first became popular, but they are still far more popular among younger age groups.
"When we were in younger years (in school) it wasn't as common and so that's why I think a lot of people in our year feel like they don't need to do it," he said.
"Whereas I think younger people feel the peer pressure to do it, to fit in with their friend groups."
Amelie, also 17, said her peers in sixth form were more likely to be "more health conscious" which deters them from taking up vaping.
The figures also show higher rates of girls vaping than boys, despite the drop in numbers.
Amelie said colourful packaging was likely to play a part.
"I'd say it's because of the marketing and the product, colourful packages, flavours," she said.
"I'd say vaping is more targeted towards girls than boys."
But she added that lessons in school explaining the risks had been powerful.
She added: "Our school is very supportive, they've taken the correct steps to educate us, including the health education lessons, and they brought in a demonstration of what our lungs could look like - the 'popcorn' lung - so that helped."
Year 10 Whitmore High School student Harrison, 14, said he feels vaping has been normalised among younger people, and there can be pressure to vape.
As a keen footballer in Barry, the risks to his own health and his performance on the pitch have been big drivers for not vaping.
"Social media comes into it, a lot of people on Youtube and TikTok do it, they're smoking or vaping and people think that's cool to do," he said.
It's illegal for under-18s to buy the product, but he said access for some people wasn't difficult.
Anabella, 14, said she had definitely seen interest in vapes decline among her peers.
"I've seen a few people start to quit, people are starting to realise the health risks, and they're seeing the people they're around that do that sort of thing, aren't the people they should be around.
"Everyone was doing it so it was a trend, and now that it's died down, less people are starting in the first place."
Henriette Bertheux is responsible for personal and social education at Whitmore High, and said higher rates of boys being involved in extra-curricular sports was also likely to be a factor in fewer of them vaping, compared to girls.
At one point pupils were requesting frequent toilet trips as they would vape in pairs in the cubicles, which naturally also impacted their learning.
She said a combination of education around the health implications and tighter rules about how many children are allowed toilet breaks at once had helped reduce the problem.
"We had a year group that were targetted quite heavily when they were in year 7 and 8, it was coming on social media and they were susceptible to that," she said, adding that cohort had now left school
"We've definitely seen a drop in the younger years."
Mary-Ann McKibben from Public Health Wales said there had been a concerted effort from schools, public health agencies and government to curb vape use.
She said: "We've had the introduction of some quite strong legislation with the ban on disposable vapes last year and then a lot of publicity surrounding the Tobacco and Vapes Act, external that will be coming into place with restrictions on packaging, marketing and content and flavours of vapes going forward.
"That all influences behaviour change, together with a rising awareness of the harm that vapes can cause.
"Technically young people shouldn't be able to get hold of vapes through legitimate means if they're under 18, so often they are at risk of illicit products that are sold on the black market that may contain all sorts of contents that are even more toxic than the normal vapes.
"So be very, very careful in terms of what you're consuming because it could really damage your health."
She added it's also important that support is offered to young people who have been vaping nicotine products, because of their addictive qualities.

title: Minnesota project shows promise of mixing farming, solar power
content:
Winifred Sylvah picked a handful of plump cucumbers on a cold, wet September morning as raindrops trickled off rows of solar panels in the background.
They’ve been a productive plant for Sylvah on a new plot of land at a solar farm in Big Lake. She’s already harvested about 140 pounds of cucumbers, with rows more waiting to be picked. Sylvah is one of three farmers working the land in between and outside the rows of a 1-megawatt solar array in Big Lake.
The Big Lake Farm is an example of agrivoltaics, a technique of mixing farming and solar power generation. The two interests are often pitted against each other in rural areas, but the rows of flourishing crops between rows of solar panels shows there’s enough sun to go around.
The farm is a partnership between The Food Group — a Minnesota-based nonprofit organization that helps emerging farmers and fights hunger — and U.S. Solar*. It allows farmers like Sylvah to affordably lease farmland while providing an additional use for land that would otherwise be fenced-in rows of panels.
The project started as a pilot in 2023, but this year was made permanent with Sylvah and two other farmers entering 10-year leases on the land. She wasn’t sure what to make of farming between panels, but after hearing from pilot project farmers and seeing new infrastructure like irrigation systems and a walk-in cooler to store freshly picked produce come to the land, Sylvah was up for the challenge.
“I decided to take a chance,” Sylvah said.
The program expansion comes as federal officials slash support for emerging farmers. In March, the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) announced $300 million in cuts for a grant program focused on supporting land and market access for new farmers, defunding three programs aimed at helping farmers of color in Minnesota, MPR News reported. The cuts are part of the Trump administration’s eradication of federal spending aimed at diversity, equity and inclusion efforts.
“Because racial equity is a core value for our organization and how we’ve set up our programming, we aren’t going to actively pursue federal grants for the next couple years,” Food Group Executive Director Sophia Lenarz-Coy told Sahan Journal.
Accessing land is a challenge for emerging farmers. The Food Group’s Big River Farms in Marine on St. Croix, Minn., is a popular incubator program for emerging farmers, many of whom are immigrants. But once they leave, farmers who can’t afford to buy land often lease plots for a year at a time, which doesn’t allow them the certainty to become certified organic or the chance to adapt to the soil over the years.
“What’s nice about people having longer term leases is they’ll have a little more time to experiment,” Leranz-Coy said.
Agrivoltaics seen as win-win
Growing between rows of solar panels offers similar yields to standard farming, according to Iowa State University Professor Ajay Nair. Nair has helped lead research on agrivoltaics in Ames, where a partnership with utility firm Alliant Energy led to a 10-acre solar garden lined with rows of crops.
Iowa State researchers have tried various fruits and vegetables in the solar garden, and for the most part are seeing the same yield as in comparison plots.
“Any grower can commercially grow their produce within an agrivoltaic system,” Nair told Sahan Journal.
There’s more space between solar rows than many assume, Nair said. Wires are deep underground and typically don’t prohibit tilling the land, and some plants benefit from rotating shade. As long as irrigation is in place, it’s a perfectly viable place to farm, he said.
There are co-benefits between farmers and solar firms, Nair said. Solar companies build large fences around their projects, which is useful for farmers. Farmers are on the land consistently and can tell the company right away if a panel has been damaged in a storm or if anything is amiss on the property. It also helps ease rural land politics by allowing solar and agriculture to co-exist.
“Having some sort of an agriculture system in there gives them the social license to operate,” Nair said.
Most agrivoltaic projects in the United States focus on livestock grazing, not produce farming. In western Minnesota, researchers at the University of Minnesota-Morris have run a successful cattle agrivoltaics plot for the past eight years.
Some 275 cows munch grass in between rows of a 500-kilowatt solar array in Morris, Minn., animal science Professor Brad Heins said. The cows benefit from the solar panels’ shade, with researchers finding less heat stress in the herd. That helps keep the cows healthier and more productive, Heins said.
“I think it’s garnered a lot of interest in Minnesota and around the world,” Heins said.
Learning curve
Sylvah came to Minnesota from Sierra Leone as a student in the 1980s. She worked in banking for more than 30 years before retirement. But she always loved growing food and has fond memories of tending the family vegetable garden with her grandmother.
She grew vegetables at home and got involved in a community garden, but when she retired she decided to make farming her profession. She got involved with The Food Group and worked a plot at Big River Farms.
The Big Lake farm is much closer to her home in Otsego. And it gives her the chance to get to know the land. She has about an acre and a half total: one acre in the solar garden and half an acre in an adjacent plot.
Sylvah has a large mix of crops. In the solar garden she planted vegetables that benefit from shade: onions, collard greens, green beans and scallions. They all did well, she said.
She’s learned from this season. She didn’t put down fabric to discourage weeds, but she will next year after spending too much time maintaining her beds.
Her banking background shines through: Sylvah is always thinking about the market for anything she grows. She’s developed a following for her West African crops. Her okra, sweet potato greens, collard greens and eggplant are in high demand, she said.
“I make sure I know people are interested in what I’m growing,” Sylvah said.
She has some bitter balls, a West African eggplant that Sylvah said is popular in Minnesota’s Liberian community, but she’s not selling any this year and instead hopes to get seeds for a larger haul next season. In late August, she put down new rows of green beans, planning a late fall harvest.
“I always will do my last harvest for Thanksgiving,” she said.
Sylvah sells her food through a Community Support Agriculture program and to local public school districts in Albertville, Minn., and Buffalo, Minn., harvesting and delivering to the schools herself this fall.
Correction: Connexus Energy is no longer a partner organization on the Big Lake solar garden.

title: Traçabilité du cacao : 600 sociétés coopératives font 100% de leurs achats avec la carte du producteur
content: La Côte d’Ivoire poursuit la mise en œuvre de son Système National de Traçabilité (SNT) du cacao, avec des premiers résultats jugés encourageants. title: Specialist rape courts to be rolled out to tackle ‘shamefully low’ prosecution rates and long wait times
content:
Specialist rape courts to be rolled out to tackle ‘shamefully low’ prosecution rates and long wait times
Prime minister Andy Burnham said the plans are ‘long overdue’
- Bookmark
- CommentsGo to comments
Specialist courtrooms to deal with rape and serious sexual offences are set to be rolled out in a bid to tackle “shamefully low” prosecution rates, Andy Burnham has announced.
Under new government plans, every Crown Court in England and Wales will have at least one courtroom especially set up to hear such cases over the next two years.
Survivors will be offered private entrances and waiting rooms in courts, as well as access to facilities equipped to pre-record evidence and observe sentencing remotely.
All court staff will also receive trauma-informed training, with a single person of contact assigned to each survivor.
The measures, which Rape Crisis England & Wales say are “necessary and long overdue”, are expected to cost around £23 million from the Ministry of Justice budget.
From October, trials will be prioritised with fixed dates rather than placed on floating lists in what the prime minister described as an effort to “rebalance the scales of justice and put victims first.”
Mr Burnham said the plans are “long overdue”, as he acknowledged those who have been “let down” by the justice system.
“Prosecution rates for rape remain shamefully low, with many victims waiting years for justice,” he said
“This is not good enough. That’s why we are making major changes to rebalance the scales of justice and put victims first. This includes rolling out specialist courtrooms for rape and serious sex offences.
“These changes are long overdue and will make a significant difference, but focusing on prosecution alone will not be enough. So as well as ensuring victims get justice, we will step up action to prevent these horrific crimes from happening in the first place.”
In its announcement, the Government credited Labour MP Charlotte Nichols’ “immense strength and bravery” in speaking publicly about being raped and calling for changes to a backlogged system.
In March, Ms Nichols waived her automatic right to anonymity in a powerful Commons speech during which she lamented having to wait more than 1,000 days to go to court
Ciara Bergman, CEO of Rape Crisis England & Wales said: “We’re particularly pleased to see measures that will improve trial efficiency and ensure survivors are better able to participate in, and observe, proceedings.
“The recognition that suitable separate waiting areas, entrances and exits are essential to prevent survivors from being intimidated and distressed by the presence of perpetrators and their supporters is also significant. This welcome change is both necessary and long overdue.”
Lord chancellor Alex Norris acknowledged victims have felt “left alone facing the criminal justice system for too long”.
“They have been treated as cases to process and not as people to support,” he said.
“The funding we are announcing today will provide that support that victims deserve – delivering courtrooms that are designed with victim needs in mind and providing specialist training for staff to handle these cases with care.
“Real action to improve our courts. Real action for victims. Real action to deliver the justice they deserve.”
Tory shadow justice secretary Nick Timothy also described the move to tackle delays is “long overdue”, but criticised the government’s decision to restrict jury trials.
“The fact that victims have been withdrawing their cases because they have taken too long has been a disgrace,” he said.
“However, rape trial delays have been used by Labour as their main justification for their attack on juries. If resources can be found to accelerate rape trials, why are they persisting in their attack on this ancient right to jury trials?
“Labour need to get courts sitting throughout the year, end the delays and clear the backlog - not undermine our right to a trial by jury.”

title: Meet the beekeeper carrying on three generations of family tradition
content:
The Honey Festival celebrates Kalbajar’s long beekeeping tradition, bringing local producers together as they promote the region’s honey and explore opportunities to reach new audiences beyond Azerbaijan.
Beekeeping has been part of Sabir Mustafayev’s family for generations. With more than 40 years in the profession, he says the craft has changed significantly, with beekeepers adapting to new challenges including global warming. His family brought its farm to Kalbajar in 2021 and later opened a honey shop there, followed by a branch in Baku. The annual Honey Festival is putting Kalbajar’s beekeeping tradition in the spotlight, as producers look to bring the region’s honey to a global audience.

title: Indonesia Parliament passes law aimed at resolving land conflicts
content:
Indonesia Parliament passes law aimed at resolving land conflicts
JAKARTA - Indonesian lawmakers passed into law on Sept 22 a provision aimed at resolving land conflicts across the country, setting up a government body under the president to undertake such tasks.
The law maps out agrarian reform priorities to address inequality in land ownership and control, agrarian conflicts, abandoned land and poverty, said Member of Parliament Iman Sukri in a streamed hearing.
An agency to address agrarian reforms will be set up and report to the president, and will be responsible for land planning, land monitoring and resolving agrarian conflicts, Iman said.
The law will also ensure equal distribution of land ownership by limiting the size of holdings, Iman said.
The law “answers the roots of agrarian inequality that has not been resolved completely”, Iman said.
Reuters could not immediately see contents of the law.
Nusron Wahid, an Indonesian minister overseeing agrarian affairs, said in the same hearing that the government will formulate technical details such as maximum and minimum limits of land ownership.
“The government hopes that with a stronger legal foundation, small farmers... fishermen, Indigenous people, and disenfranchised communities... can feel the state’s presence through a just agrarian reform”, he said.
Conflicts over land ownership are related to overlapping claims over forest areas, state assets and private land, often involving local communities, private sectors and state-owned companies, Nusron has said.
Indonesia’s President Prabowo Subianto has ordered the seizure of land from miners and companies that the authorities have said violated forest utilisation rules. REUTERS

title: Zeca Pagodinho recebe título de embaixador da agricultura urbana por horta em Duque de Caxias (RJ)
content:
A Horta Urbana Xerém I, em Duque de Caxias (RJ), recebeu um importante reconhecimento do governo federal pelo trabalho em prol da segurança alimentar na Baixada Fluminense. O espaço ocupa um terreno de 8 mil metros quadrados cedido pelo cantor e compositor Zeca Pagodinho para produção de alimentos que são destinados às famílias mais vulneráveis da comunidade.
O projeto mantido pelo Instituto Zeca Pagodinho (IZP) produz frutas, legumes e hortaliças para cerca de 10 mil famílias em parceria com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar (MDA), a Universidade Federal Rural do Rio (UFRRJ) e a Embrapa Agrobiologia.
De julho de 2025 a junho de 2026, foram colhidas duas toneladas de alimentos que são doados ao Fórum de Cozinhas Solidárias do RJ. A visita do governo federal também marcou uma nova etapa da parceria com o IZP para ampliar o reflorestamento e iniciar a produção de café e cacau em outros 13 mil metros quadrados de terras doadas pelo cantor.
Diante da importância desse trabalho, na última terça-feira (15), uma comitiva do governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) desembarcou em Caxias para conceder a Zeca o título de Embaixador da Agricultura Urbana e Periurbana.
O momento contou com a presença da ministra Fernanda Machiavelli, do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar (MDA), e de Wellington Dias, do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome.
:: Quer receber notícias do Brasil de Fato RJ no seu WhatsApp? ::
“Hoje estamos aqui para reconhecer o trabalho do cantor e compositor Zeca Pagodinho, como embaixador da agricultura urbana e periurbana no Brasil, ao disponibilizar essa área, organizar a produção e garantir que esses alimentos saudáveis possam chegar para as famílias da região”, declarou a ministra do MDA, Fernanda Machiaveli.
O título de embaixador reconhece de forma simbólica a promoção de hortas comunitárias, quintais agroecológicos urbanos e periurbanos, além da formação de competências locais para produção de alimentos saudáveis, aliando agroecologia, economia solidária e segurança alimentar.
“É um trabalho muito bonito e muito importante para aproximar a produção do consumo, para que a gente consiga de fato trazer a agricultura para perto de quem vive na cidade e para a mesa do povo brasileiro”, completou Machiaveli.

title: 유네스코 등재 10년 '숨비소리' 울려 퍼진다…제주해녀축제 개막(종합)
content:
제19회 제주해녀축제 개막, 20일까지 진행
유네스코 등재 10주년…해녀 등 1천여명 참석
제주해녀 작년 2천371명으로 감소세 지속

제19회 제주해녀축제 개막, 20일까지 진행
유네스코 등재 10주년…해녀 등 1천여명 참석
제주해녀 작년 2천371명으로 감소세 지속
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(제주=연합뉴스) 변지철 기자 = 제주해녀문화의 유네스코 인류무형문화유산 등재 10주년을 기념하는 제19회 제주해녀축제가 19일 제주시 구좌읍 해녀박물관 일대에서 막을 올렸다.
올해 축제는 '인류무형문화유산 등재 10년의 발자취, 숨비소리에 실어 보낸 고백'을 주제로 20일까지 이틀간 열린다.
개막 첫날인 이날 현장에는 제주를 비롯해 강원과 경북, 울산, 부산, 경남 등 전국에서 찾아온 해녀 등 1천여명이 함께했다.
행사는 해녀의 무사안녕과 풍요로운 바다를 기원하는 해녀굿으로 시작했다.
이어 해녀들이 물질할 때 사용하는 테왁과 망사리 등 해녀를 상징하는 물품을 들고 거리행진을 펼치며 축제 분위기를 달궜다.
제9회 해녀의 날 기념식에서는 제주해녀 헌장 낭독과 모범해녀·해녀축제 유공자 표창, 축하공연 등이 진행됐다
특히 유네스코 등재 10주년을 맞아 어린이 창작뮤지컬과 해녀와 어린이 합창공연, 특별공연 등을 통해 제주해녀문화의 세대 전승 의미를 되새겼다.
위성곤 제주지사는 "해녀 한 분이 줄어들 때마다 오랜 기술과 지식, 공동체의 기억도 함께 흐릿해진다"며 "해녀의 삶을 지키고 새로운 해녀를 키우는 일이 곧 제주해녀문화의 미래를 지키는 길"이라고 말했다.
허민 국가유산청장은 "제주해녀문화는 삶의 지혜와 공동체적인 삶을 담은 인류무형유산"이라며 "소중한 해녀문화를 보호하고 전승해 전 세계가 함께 누릴 수 있도록 지원을 아끼지 않겠다"고 밝혔다.
축제 기간 공연과 경연, 체험, 전시 등 5개 부문 33개 프로그램이 펼쳐진다.
해녀들이 직접 무대에 오르는 '숨비가요제'와 현직 해녀들의 삶과 이야기를 들어보는 '불턱토크쇼', 해녀 물질 체험 등이 마련된다.
어린이와 가족 관람객은 전통 해녀복을 입고 해녀와 함께 사진을 찍는 '숨비스냅' 등을 즐길 수 있다.
올해는 축제를 밤까지 즐길 수 있도록 노을을 보며 해안길을 걷고 쓰레기를 줍는 '쓰담 달리기'와 음악·조명이 어우러진 '디제이 공연'도 새롭게 선보인다.
제주해녀문화는 1971년 제주도 무형유산 지정을 시작으로 2016년 11월 유네스코 인류무형문화유산, 2017년 5월 국가무형유산, 2023년 11월 세계중요농어업유산에 잇따라 이름을 올렸다.
하지만 제주해녀는 1970년 1만4천143명에서 2000년 5천789명, 2015년 4천377명, 2020년 3천614명에 이어 지난해 2천371명으로 줄었다.
이에 제주도는 해녀 진료비와 고령해녀 수당, 신규 해녀 정착 등을 지원하고 수산자원 조성과 소라 가격 안정 사업도 추진하고 있다.
제주도는 이번 축제를 계기로 제주해녀문화의 지난 10년을 돌아보고 제주해녀축제를 세계인이 함께 즐기는 해양문화축제로 키워나갈 계획이다.
